map.冰箱耗电量估算 使用指南: Refrigerator power consumption estimator user guide
map.输入冰箱容积、能效等级与环境温度，工具估算每日耗电量与全年电费，辅助选购节能机型: Enter refrigerator capacity, energy-efficiency grade and ambient temperature; the tool estimates daily power consumption and the annual electricity bill, helping you choose an energy-saving model or assess the running cost of an existing refrigerator.
map.日耗电 ≈ 额定功率 × 24 × 负载系数: Daily consumption is about rated power x 24 x load factor
map.根据冰箱容积、能效等级、环境温度估算日耗电量和年电费: Estimates daily power consumption and annual electricity cost from refrigerator capacity, energy-efficiency grade and ambient temperature
map.选购时按能效标识估年电费。: When buying, estimate the annual electricity cost from the energy-efficiency label.
map.老旧冰箱与新一级能效对比。: Compare an old refrigerator with a new grade-1 efficiency model.
map.环境温度和开门频率对耗电影响。: Effect of ambient temperature and door-opening frequency on power consumption.
map.：旧冰箱标称日耗 1.5 kWh、新一级日耗 0.6 kWh：年差 (1.5−0: : An old refrigerator rated at 1.5 kWh/day versus a new grade-1 model at 0.6 kWh/day: the annual difference is (1.5 - 0.6) x 365, about 328 kWh, and about 190 CNY in electricity. Note: actual use is affected by ambient temperature (higher temperature increases consumption), storage load and defrosting, so the rating is idealized.
map.由质量、比热与温升求热量: Heat from mass, specific heat and temperature rise
map.标称日耗电准吗？: Is the nominal daily consumption accurate?
map.按标准工况（25℃、特定负载）测得，实际夏冬与开门频次差异大，仅作相对比较。: Measured under standard conditions (25 °C, specific load); actual summer/winter results and door-opening frequency vary widely, so use it for relative comparison only.
map.远离热源、留散热间隙、少开门、适当温度（冷藏 4–5℃、冷冻 −18℃）、及时除: Keep away from heat sources, leave clearance for heat dissipation, open the door less often, set a suitable temperature (4-5 °C for refrigeration, -18 °C for freezing) and defrost promptly.
